analysis: Feature-level genetic anchoring (Gate 6 + Gate 7) — extension of the 'Stable but confounded' reproduction
parent_reproduction: consolidation-cautionary/ (Layer A + Layer B of the postmortem-psychiatric subtyping paper)
manuscript: Chauhan 2026, 'Stable but confounded: brain region, not diagnosis, drives a validation-passing molecular subtype in postmortem psychiatric brain', Research Square 10.21203/rs.3.rs-8913089 (under revision)

framework.gate_integration: Gate 7 (genetic anchoring) and Gate 6 (confound association) are shipped framework gates: ValidationGates.genetic_anchoring_gate / ValidationGates.confound_association_gate, backed by pathway_subtyping.genetics (v0.8.0 line)
framework.deposited_outputs_produced_with: pathway-subtyping 0.7.0 (PyPI) + the Gate-7 prototype now folded into the package; numbers verified identical through the integrated gate

risk_reference.note: causally-prior GWAS/rare-variant-derived; SFARI Gene was allowlist-blocked, Open Targets used as an independent genetics-grounded substitute

test_sets.NEURONAL_SYNAPTIC: SYNAPTIC_TRANSMISSION + GLUTAMATE_SIGNALING + GABA_SIGNALING (schizophrenia_pathways.gmt); n=54 mapped to Ensembl

nulls.genome_wide: Ensembl protein-coding universe (BioMart), N=23272 — reference only, does not decide the gate
nulls.brain_expressed_matched: GSE80655 genes detected in >=50% of samples, N=36971 — the discriminating null that decides the gate

test: one-sided hypergeometric over-representation, BH-adjusted across subtypes

headline.gate6: passed=false; max nuisance Cramer's V=0.66 (brain region, chi2=125.1, p~4e-26); diagnosis exempt (V=0.0, p=0.408)
headline.gate7: DISCRIMINATION CONFIRMED under brain-expressed-matched null: NEURONAL/SYNAPTIC fold 16.51x p=1.04e-23; GLIAL/IMMUNE fold 2.65x p=0.17 (n.s.). Recovers Voineagu F5. Gate-7 calibration passes.
headline.null_matters: matched null raises neuronal fold 10.14x -> 16.51x (risk genes concentrate in the brain-expressed background), so a genome-wide null understates true enrichment here and would overstate it for a region-artifact subtype

usage_note: Research use only. Not clinical guidance.
